title: QUIZ - 40
description: Test your knowledge, strengthen your reasoning, and learn something new with every question.

questions.learningObjective: Expand an expression by distributing a factor over a sum or difference
questions.question: Apply the distributive property to expand: \( 5(y + 12) \)
questions.explanation: Multiply 5 by each term inside the parentheses: \(5 \times y = 5y\), and \(5 \times 12 = 60\). Result: 5y + 60.
questions.hint: Multiply the outside factor by every term inside the parentheses.

questions.learningObjective: Expand an expression by distributing a factor over a sum or difference
questions.question: Apply the distributive property to expand: \( 6(m + 12) \)
questions.explanation: Multiply 6 by each term inside the parentheses: \(6 \times m = 6m\), and \(6 \times 12 = 72\). Result: 6m + 72.
questions.hint: Multiply the outside factor by every term inside the parentheses.

questions.learningObjective: Expand an expression by distributing a negative factor over a difference
questions.question: Apply the distributive property to expand: \( -4(m - 6) \)
questions.explanation: Distribute -4: \(-4 \times m = -4m\), and \(-4 \times (-6) = 24\). Result: -4m + 24.
questions.hint: Be careful with signs: a negative factor distributed over a subtraction produces a positive constant term.

questions.learningObjective: Distribute two separate factors across parentheses and combine the resulting like terms
questions.question: Simplify using the distributive property: \( 4(t + 5) - 3(t - 7) \)
questions.explanation: Distribute both terms: 4(t+5) = 4t+20, and -3(t-7) = -3t+21. Combining: (4-3)t + (20+21) = 1t + 41.
questions.hint: Distribute each part separately, being careful with the sign in front of the second parentheses, then combine like terms.
